idea-plugin.name: Socle (Chisel)
idea-plugin.description: Chisel IDE support: a View design action on each ChiselSim test opens the elaborated design in a panel beside the editor, and the schematic follows your cursor. The Socle tool window lists the project's tests (View design and Simulate on each), the design's instance hierarchy and the details of the selection.

server.name: Socle
server.description: The Socle language server: View design and Simulate on ChiselSim tests, and the live design panel.
